details.report:
R1: Refactor `src/recorder/config.ts` into explicit byte-read, pure structure, metadata-scan, and state-validation operations, and have `src/recorder/run.ts` assign `config-read → config-structure → config-metadata-scan → config-state` before each call. Finish provenance and all config-only cross-field/reserved-path checks in the pure phase. Replace every `invalid-config` location with the exact safe field/index/container location (`[]` only for malformed JSON or root-object defects), and make structural path conversion catch only a known `RecorderError` whose code is `invalid-path`; unknown throws remain available to the shared `internal-error` wrapper.
R2: Make the config boundary the sole owner of declaration ID legality/uniqueness, reserved generated IDs and paths, required authority/task declarations, duplicate canonical structural reference identities, and other config-only conflicts. Remove the corresponding duplicate checks and impossible stored-path guards from `src/recorder/admit.ts`, and move/remove reserved policy constants/helpers from `src/recorder/paths.ts`; retain admission checks that require filesystem/Git/content/digest state. This avoids repeating the incomplete ownership split introduced by `b18af98`.
R3: In `src/recorder/run.ts`, install `childOutcomeFromSpawn(spawnResult, null)` immediately after `spawnOnce` settles, before tee reads or scans, then only enrich its bounded diagnostic without changing exit/signal truth. Assign truthful post-spawn/extraction, `generated-artifacts`, `manifest`, `cleanup`, and `promotion` stages around their owning operations. Convert manifest and redaction-report closure divergence to safely diagnosed `internal-error`, preserve owner-established typed errors, and change `src/recorder/errors.ts` to one finite allow-listed platform-code classifier rather than the broad `E*` rule.
R4: Extend the owning Recorder suites (primarily `test/recorder-cli.test.ts`, `test/recorder-admission.test.ts`, `test/recorder-transaction.test.ts`, schema/package lifecycle tests, and shared harness only where production seams already permit) with a table-driven production location matrix covering root/nested/scalar/enum/path/hash/ID/environment/declaration/provenance/duplicate/reserved/missing-role cases; ordering canaries proving pure defects precede scanner and all stateful work; unknown sentinels for every required stage; exact post-spawn exited/signaled failure outcomes; and real `bin/ak-docket-record.js` outputs for all child shapes validated against `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json`. Assert no secret, value, argv, environment, stack/message, or attacker-controlled key leakage. Do not add test-only production hooks; graduate useful probes once and delete scratch copies. Regenerate `dist/recorder/*` and verify source/dist/schema/package consistency.
R5: During apply, run focused Recorder tests, full `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:recorder`, `npm pack --dry-run`, `git diff --check`, package-content checks, and Judge-listed searches for broad unknown laundering, stale/unassigned stages, absent/false-root config locations, late structural checks, and manifest-owned `admission-failed`. Inspect the final diff/worktree, then create one new forward commit (no amend/rewrite) and confirm HEAD descends from the opening HEAD. The new forward evidence will explicitly retract the immutable review-001 receipt’s unsupported R1/R2/R4 completion claims and R6 regression/schema-proof implication, cite only current-head results, preserve the historical-root non-claim, and keep issue #13 excluded.
